Proposed population, conditions, visibility, support admission, measurements, gates, and claim boundary.
Unratified requested scope and forbidden follow-up, repair, transport, heldout, and claim actions.
Controlling recurrence graph, feedback-as-attention rule, rung ordering, and calibration-only claim boundary.
System thesis, experiment-to-claim map, visibility invariants, and required baseline interpretation.

system_thesis_interpretation: The smallest identifiable thesis test is the thinker-to-later-dream return edge: with one byte-identical pre-feedback history and matched branch compute, an own typed frontier should increase postcommit formation of its recipient-local route/effect connection over no feedback and a distinct same-kind distractor. The present proposal additionally asks a fresh thinker to solve the final paired counterfactual, but the implemented DIRECTED_PATH contract cannot certify that conjunctive task. A valid answer requires role identification, route-to-effect binding, CHANGE/STABLE semantics, passive baseline selection, blocked-source contribution, subtraction-or-identity arithmetic, and answer-label resolution. A one-edge source-to-target path proves none of those conjuncts and currently outputs the target entity rather than the counterfactual outcome label.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph correctly separates a non-evidentiary frontier, later dreaming, status admission, frozen text memory, and a fresh thinker, but public_evidence_support_admission is not attribution-neutral. The public compiler exposes the exact source, target, and causal_join relation; bounded retrieval prioritizes those atoms; and the admission rule recognizes canonical route/effect ontology and mechanically promotes an exact four-citation proposal. This may measure successful copying/citation formatting plus compiler assistance rather than independent model derivation. Option A, minimal answer-blind CITED_SUPPORT with free model reasoning and strictly offline correctness/proof scoring, minimizes in-loop ontology leakage but cannot call arbitrary citations an entailing proof. Option B, a public DERIVE kernel that validates every role/effect/baseline/contribution/arithmetic step, can certify a proof but leaks the task ontology and must be accompanied by a compiler-only, no-model ceiling; its success is not wholly attributable to the model. Option C removes final-answer release from this first transition and scores only recurrence closure after commitment. C is the recommended first GPU graph because it isolates the named return edge with the fewest additional solver assumptions.
loop_delta_interpretation: The shared prefix must execute physically once per life and be cloned byte-identically before selection. For seeds 0 and 2, each of four lives contributes 46+22+16 shared dream calls and 16 calls in each of three branches; seed 1 contributes the analogous 49+24+16 and 16x3 for two lives, yielding exactly 802 physical dream calls. THINK_0 is also physical once per life; final branch thinkers are separate, so thinker operations are at most 288 and are not padded after a terminal. These recurrent counts exclude transcript/RAG/wake-only baseline calls, which require their own predeclared physical slots, tokens, retrieval reads, and attribution. Under recommended option C, freeze MEMORY_1 and score exact own-frontier closure offline without revealing or answering the final question. Under a later option-A transition, reveal the final public question only after MEMORY_1 and accept a schema-valid answer plus retrieved supported citations, while scoring answer correctness, citation relevance, proof completeness, and paired behavior offline as separate metrics. Option B belongs in the same job only as an explicitly labeled compiler ceiling, never as the primary model condition.
claim_delta_interpretation: As written, a positive DIRECTED_PATH release is ineligible evidence for paired final correctness or mechanically valid counterfactual support. Six aligned development lives permit a development-interface result, not statistical reliability, robustness, scale, memory advantage, or a headline. Recommended option C can support only: an own non-evidentiary typed frontier changed bounded later dreaming and increased postcommit formation of the predeclared recipient-local connection relative to both controls. It cannot show that the connection was sufficient for the final decision. A later answer-blind option-A result could add paired final behavior if accuracy and complete public-proof coverage are scored independently after commitment. Option B can establish a compiler-assisted proof ceiling, but any gain that disappears without its public ontology/kernel belongs to the resolution protocol rather than recurrence or model reasoning.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The private answer, latent bit, oracle proof, scorer path, and final question are correctly forbidden before MEMORY_1, but answer blindness alone is insufficient. Public ontology can leak the intended solution decomposition without leaking hidden truth: the exact agenda endpoints/relation, canonical route/effect record grammar, support outcome, and supported status visible to the later thinker reveal what the mechanical checker recognized. Admission decisions must therefore be treated as a public derived channel and ablated. For option C, keep admission and all truth/proof scoring offline so no accepted/rejected status steers subsequent cognition; retain raw proposals and citations unchanged. For option A, only raw public memory status established independently of the final answer may be visible, and offline proof scoring must not feed a retry. For option B, the exposed DERIVE vocabulary and validator responses must be declared model-visible solver assistance, with no adaptive error detail or retry beyond the frozen operation budget.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The proposed tests are necessary but the current evidence mapping is not sufficient to launch the claimed final-goal experiment. Before any GPU call, trusted replay must rebuild the actual chosen objective rather than a one-edge surrogate; DREAM scientific mode must forbid direct mark_supported decisions and preserve proposal, exact cited bytes, parser, admission reason, and append-only status as separate artifacts; private/final mutations must leave every precommit model and admission byte invariant; and schedule tests must reconcile 802 physical recurrent dream calls, at most 288 physical thinker operations, shared-prefix attribution, early terminals, plus every baseline call/read/token separately. The shortcut gate must add raw rendered text, order/position, IDs, combined route-effect features, agenda endpoints, canonical admission strings, and compiler-only predictors rather than rely on the current feature lookup that explicitly omits valve-route joins. The bounded-view test must quantify candidate-set size and add query-copy, connector-choice, citation-permutation, masked-content, wrong-connector, irrelevant-citation, and mechanical no-model admission controls. If option C is ratified, t_p1_public_final_goal_paired_thinker and final-answer baselines move to a separate intake and this run instead requires blinded offline exact-closure scoring. If option A is later ratified, RELEASE must be renamed/typed as CITED_SUPPORT and tests must prove that final correctness, citation relevance, and full conjunctive proof coverage are reported separately. If option B is later ratified, every DERIVE rule, response, and retry is model-visible compute and a compiler-only ceiling is mandatory. Immutable dual review, durable markers, complete manifests, exact human scope, and the unconditional postcommit human stop remain hard gates in all options.
assumptions: Seeds 0, 1, and 2 and both twins are development-only calibration units; threshold counts are routing gates, not confidence intervals or population estimates.
The agenda arm intentionally reveals the desired source, target, and relation as selection coordinates; this is the experimental treatment and must not be described as autonomous target discovery.
A generic causal_join records route/effect association but does not encode effect polarity or the other conjuncts required by the final counterfactual answer.
The full transcript, RAG, wake-only memory, and compiler ceilings use the same pinned model where applicable and have separately auditable physical calls and retrieval compute.
No result, admission outcome, offline proof score, or baseline result can trigger a retry, repair, transport run, replication, heldout access, or claim promotion.

ambiguities.question: Does CITED_SUPPORT mean only that cited supported records were retrieved, or that those records mechanically entail every conjunct of the final answer?
ambiguities.impact: The former permits answer-blind behavioral scoring but not a valid-proof claim; the latter requires a new proof contract and introduces solver ontology.

ambiguities.question: Is recurrence closure the generic source-to-target causal_join currently implemented, or an effect-polarized relation that preserves CHANGE versus STABLE?
ambiguities.impact: The generic edge can test attention-guided association but cannot be claimed to make the arithmetic outcome available without additional typed content.

ambiguities.question: Are public-witness admission outcomes and supported status visible to later dream calls, only to the final thinker, or only to offline scoring?
ambiguities.impact: Visibility changes whether the checker is merely a scorer, an in-loop teacher, or a memory co-author and therefore changes causal attribution.

ambiguities.question: What exact model-call, retrieval-read, prompt-token, generated-token, and wall-time envelopes are predeclared for full-context, iterative-RAG, and wake-only baselines?
ambiguities.impact: Without exact baseline slots, the experiment-wide ledger cannot substantiate matched compute or interpret a recurrent advantage.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: DIRECTED_PATH cannot certify v0.3-R's conjunctive role/effect/baseline/contribution/arithmetic outcome, so the proposed final RELEASE and paired-goal claim are not currently eligible.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The hardened contract proves only a supported graph path from an anchor entity to an output entity. The current compiler constructs a one-edge source-to-target causal_join goal and returns the target entity label; it neither represents nor validates the counterfactual answer label or its required public derivation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rework this intake to option C for the first GPU transition. Move final-goal answering to a separate ratified option-A transition, or add option B only as a labeled compiler ceiling with full conjunctive rules and attribution ablations.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed mechanical public-evidence admission cannot be treated as neutral evidence that the model independently re-derived the connection.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The agenda supplies exact endpoints and relation, retrieval prioritizes them, canonical memory exposes route/effect syntax, and the admission rule recognizes the connector and promotes the edge. A model can succeed by copying the requested tuple and mechanically admissible citations while the checker contributes the decisive ontology and verification.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Make raw proposal closure the option-C primary metric under offline scoring; add no-model compiler admission, query-copy, masked-content, citation-permutation, wrong-connector, and distractor controls. Attribute only the residual over those controls to model recurrence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The existing v0.3-R shortcut audit is insufficient for the proposed live text and admission interfaces.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The current trained lookup uses goal, passive, effects, source, and role families while explicitly excluding valve-route joins; it does not audit raw rendered text/order/IDs, agenda coordinates, canonical compiler strings, support status, or combined route-effect features exposed by the live pipeline.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require the expanded exact-byte shortcut and compiler-only audit to pass on 1000 collision pairs before any provider call, and report every surviving predictor even when the paired gate passes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The stated 802 dream and at-most-288 thinker counts do not by themselves reconcile the full frozen job because the required transcript, RAG, and wake-only baselines also consume model and retrieval compute.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Shared-prefix physical execution and arm attribution are well-defined for recurrent conditions, but baseline calls are outside those totals. Without predeclared baseline slots and token/read accounting, matched-compute interpretation is incomplete.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Publish separate physical and attributed ledgers for recurrent calls and a complete schedule for every baseline; reconcile all provider receipts, early terminals, tokens, reads, and wall time before scoring.

open_questions: Does Rohin ratify the benchmark recommendation to narrow the first GPU transition to option C, recurrence closure only, with the final question never revealed in this run?

For a later final-behavior transition, does Rohin choose option A, minimal answer-blind CITED_SUPPORT with separate offline correctness and proof scoring, while retaining option B only as a compiler-only ceiling?
